Commercial use needs the Solicitor General's prior approval.

legislation.name: Acts
legislation.via: Revised Laws of Mauritius, Attorney General's Office (attorneygeneral.govmu.org); National Assembly of Mauritius (mauritiusassembly.govmu.org): Acts as passed; Supreme Court of Mauritius website (supremecourt.govmu.org): judgment search (subordinate courts) and legislation library
legislation.note: ~660 Acts consolidated in the AG's Revised Laws (mostly to 30 June 2017, a few later issues; title search); Acts as passed 2009-2023 (National Assembly; 2018 from the AG, number only) and 2024 on (Supreme Court library). Missing: post-2017 amendments are not merged into any online consolidation; National Assembly tables lack some PDFs (e.g. 2014: 6 of ~12); whether the AG A-Z list holds every Act in force is unverified.
